ui.offline: You're offline. The game keeps running; the next location may fail to load until you reconnect.
ui.title.overwrite_body: Your current save will be replaced. You can export it first from the pause menu.
ui.preplay.title: Before you begin
ui.preplay.intro: Choose how you'd like to play. Everything here can be changed later in Settings.
ui.warning.title: Content notice
ui.warning.body: This story involves darkness, storms, flood peril, distressing sounds, grief and the loss of life in a river accident. There is no combat or gore. Tension can be softened with the low-tension option.
ui.settings.title: Settings
ui.settings.voice_note: Spoken dialogue is Bangla. Subtitles can be shown in Bangla or English independently of the interface language. This build uses wordless placeholder voices until recorded performances are delivered.
ui.settings.quality_d: Texture detail changes apply from the next location.
ui.settings.dynres_d: Lowers render scale briefly to keep motion smooth.
ui.settings.captions_d: Describes important sounds and where they come from.
ui.settings.highlight_d: A soft glow marks the nearest thing you can use.
ui.settings.low_tension_d: The Watcher is slower and more forgiving.
ui.settings.slow_lantern_d: Plays the light pattern at half speed.
ui.audio.boost_d: Raises voices and lowers the mix under them.
ui.controls.gamepad: Gamepad: left stick move · A interact · RT run · B crouch · RB lantern · View journal · Menu pause · Y hint. Menus and puzzles are fully navigable with the D-pad.
ui.pause.title: Paused
ui.pause.checkpoint_body: You'll return to the last checkpoint. Clues you've found are kept.
ui.pause.quit_body: Progress since the last checkpoint is saved except your exact position.
ui.save.none: There is no save to export yet.
ui.save.import_body: It will replace your current save and continue from its checkpoint.
ui.save.failed: Couldn't save progress. Export your save from the pause menu to keep it safe.
ui.save.quota: Browser storage is full, so progress couldn't be saved. Free up space or export your save from the pause menu.
ui.save.newer: Your save is from a newer version of the game and can't be loaded here.
ui.journal.title: Journal
ui.puzzle.skip_body: The story continues as if you solved it. This is recorded only in your local save.
ui.fail.caught: The river keeps what it takes… not tonight.
ui.threat.sweep_coming: [A light is about to sweep the reeds]
ui.end.title: Return to title
ui.end.body: Episode 1 complete. Your choice has been saved. You can continue from the title screen to revisit the final decision.
ui.licenses.title: Credits & licenses
ui.licenses.intro: Every asset in this game is original work released under CC0, or third-party material under the licence shown. Nothing is loaded from third-party servers at runtime.
ui.error.webgl_body: This browser or device can't start the game's graphics. Update your browser, enable hardware acceleration, or try Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari on a desktop computer.
ui.error.load_body: Check your connection and try again. Your progress up to the last checkpoint is saved.
ui.error.context_body: The browser reset the graphics device. The game is trying to recover. If it doesn't, reload from your last checkpoint.
people.rafi.name: Rafi Hossain
people.rafi.body: My younger brother. Fifteen when the Moynamoti disappeared. He worked as a deck helper for Uncle Jalal and was proud of it. The town said he ran away to Dhaka.
people.karim.name: Karim Mia
people.karim.body: The old ghat caretaker. He knew Rafi and me as children. He says his memory is 'a torn net', but he never left the river.
people.mira.name: Mira
people.mira.body: A boat mechanic at Char Kalia. She found Rafi's phone in the mud and charged it. That's how his queued message reached me twelve years late.
people.jalal.name: Captain Jalal Uddin
people.jalal.body: Master of the M.V. Moynamoti. Rafi called him Uncle Jalal. He was the kind of man who turned back for people.
people.talukder.name: Chairman H. Talukder
people.talukder.body: He signed the notice saying the ferry never sailed. His name is on the Sonali Earthworks sign too.
people.watcher.name: The River Watcher
people.watcher.body: A tall figure that follows me in the dark. Talukder's night man, Mira says. Or something the river keeps.
people.tuli.name: Tuli
people.tuli.body: Nur Banu's daughter. Six years old that night. Rafi lifted her onto the roof. She survived, and Karim raised her as his granddaughter in secret.
credits.cast.body:
Asha · Karim · Mira · Rafi
(voice performances to be recorded)
credits.engineering.body: Runtime, tools and content pipeline: ALEYA team, with AI assistance
credits.art.body: Procedural environments, materials and characters (original, CC0)
credits.audio.body: Synthesised ambience, effects and score (original, CC0)
credits.dedication.body: For everyone who waits by the river for someone who did not come home.
credits.notice: This is a work of fiction. Bakultola, its people and the Moynamoti are invented.
credits.epilogue.A: The names were spoken aloud. Some truths cost the people who carry them.
credits.epilogue.B: The truth waited one more monsoon, and came home with a witness.
